_comment: Heuristic ranges from account usage Apr–Jun 2026. Not exact per-prompt pricing.

twin-ui.label: Twin UI (full)
twin-ui.notes: Orchestrator + 2 subagents + spec; agents run targeted tests; full matrix via ./run_all_tests in a new terminal (orchestrator does not ingest suite logs)

cost-twin-ui.label: Cost Twin UI (abbreviated)
cost-twin-ui.notes: Narrow file scope; one test file per platform; same end gate as Twin UI — ./run_all_tests in a new terminal without ingesting logs

publish-on-web.label: Publish on web
publish-on-web.notes: Agent launches local + production gates in new terminals (auto-read); ship branch; optional merge to main; up to 3 full retries with redeploy; excludes Railway/hosting fees
